summary: The simulated workflow, OpenAI provider and real-model acceptance runner are verified offline. Paid acceptance awaits credentials and explicit budgets.

items.title: Five-agent console
items.notes: React dashboard, orchestration, streaming, virtual workspace and human approval.

items.title: Runtime correctness
items.notes: Revision-bound evidence, permissions, cancellation, restart isolation and reported usage.

items.title: OpenAI Responses provider
items.notes: Opt-in provider; validated calls, continuation and usage. All workspace operations remain simulated.

items.title: Regression suite and CI
items.notes: 101 tests (12 acceptance-runner regressions), 42 simulator checks and build/typechecks passed locally Sep 7. Runtime CI on prior main is green; delivery checks are tracked in the acceptance PR.

items.title: Offline browser acceptance
items.notes: Fresh offline browser proof: 59 tool calls, held for approval then Done, no active agents. No paid requests.

items.title: Visual progress document and controls
items.notes: PRs #5–7 merged: durable update rules, light mode, sorting/filtering and fixed-height pagination. Original checkout contains separate user HTML edits.

items.title: Roadmap and status reconciliation
items.notes: Current roadmap and ledger now separate tooling from paid acceptance. Historical Phase 0 PR #4 is superseded by this reconciliation.

items.title: Real model acceptance runner
items.notes: Preflight and explicit two-run execution, gate validation, budget stops, cancellation and private reports. Twelve offline regressions pass; live acceptance remains pending.

items.title: Provider access and spending limits
items.notes: Sep 7 preflight: OPENAI_API_KEY, RUN_BUDGET_USD and LIFETIME_BUDGET_USD are missing from the runner environment. No paid requests made.

items.title: Hosting decision
items.notes: Old Vercel deployment state unverified. No GitHub deployment records returned; this does not prove no hosting exists.

items.title: Real model acceptance
items.notes: Runner and private transcripts/reports are implemented and tested offline. Two consecutive real OpenAI passes remain blocked by credentials and approved budget settings.

items.title: Budget ceiling assurance
items.notes: Reported usage enforcement exists; in-flight calls can overshoot and missing usage remains unknown.

items.title: Persistent runs and restart recovery
items.notes: Durable events, replay/resume and mid-run crash recovery. Current state is in memory.

items.title: API authentication
items.notes: Token enforcement and protected API/SSE access before remote exposure.

items.title: Run history and transcript export
items.notes: Historical run API, picker and exports depend on persistent storage.

items.title: Browser regression tests in CI
items.notes: Unit tests/build/selfchecks exist; add browser workflow coverage.

items.title: Dashboard controls and fidelity
items.notes: Provider/cache labels exist. Wire Snapshot and Reassign; correct activity footer and reconcile remaining checklist.

items.title: Real repository workspace
items.notes: Isolated files, restricted commands, Git operations, configurable goals and GitHub PR integration.

items.title: Real feature delivery acceptance
items.notes: Prepare sandbox; prove real tests, agent PR, approval hold and human-approved merge.

items.title: Packaging and deployment
items.notes: Container/runbook, persistent storage, secrets, HTTPS and selected host.

items.title: Remote and phone acceptance
items.notes: Verify authenticated deployed dashboard, mock and budgeted real runs; document deployment.
